verdict.rationale: Figma's public pricing page fragments show tier-gated features (e.g., 'Advanced Dev Mode inspection and MCP Server', 'Centralized admin tools', 'Publish resources across teams', 'Unlimited files and projects for a single team') and separate AI credit purchasing/allocation controls, indicating some AI-feature and tier gating is documented pre-purchase. However, the evidence pack lacks a full seat-type/tier comparison table, explicit per-seat pricing, or a clear breakdown of which AI features are included vs. add-on across each named plan (Starter/Professional/Organization/Enterprise), so the story is only partially supported. Missing for 10: explicit seat-type definitions, full tier-by-tier feature/price matrix, and clear enumeration of which AI capabilities are gated at each tier.
